prompt: On our Umbraco 17 Razor site, show a localized health-check warning to visitors. We support English, Danish, and German, use Dictionary items, and need a safe fallback if the translation is missing.
expectations: The response explicitly chooses Razor only because frontend presentation was requested and keeps the check logic out of the view
Dictionary aliases are stable and organised by feature and message purpose rather than translated names
English, Danish, and German values are treated as deliberate supported cultures
The fallback order is explicit and ends in a safe non-sensitive invariant message or failure state
Razor output is encoded and does not expose configuration secrets
